arguments.message: You can trim your own email volume right away in your personal settings. Open **Profile → Notifications** – the options are per‑person, not controlled by an admin, and changes take effect immediately for only your account. Turn off the notification types you don’t need (e.g., mentions, status‑change, digest) and leave **Assignment** notifications on if you only want alerts about items assigned to you. This will stop the irrelevant emails you’re seeing.
